text: それじゃあ　いい　わざ　おしえて　あげよう！

structure.jp: おしえて　あげよう！

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: おしえて　あげよう
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says you do the thing as a favor for someone. おしえて　あげよう = 'I'll teach it to you'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending on a verb says 'I'll do it' or 'let's do it'. あげよう = 'I'll give'.
